caption: The drawing depicts a richly decorated Victorian-era bedroom with a blue-green patterned wallpaper featuring large red floral motifs and diamond-shaped gold accents. A dark wooden bed with ornate carvings and a tall headboard is positioned on the right, topped with white bedding adorned with pink bows. Next to the bed is a wooden nightstand holding a water pitcher and basin, both white with pink floral designs, and a matching chamber pot below. In front of the bed, a green carpet covers the floor, and a brown dog lies on a rectangular, brown-striped rug to the far right, near a pair of blue slippers. A round braided rug in blues and earth tones is on the left, with a short, round, tasseled stool in gold and pink resting on it. An upholstered red velvet chair with elaborate wooden framing sits beside a small wooden table with curved legs and a letter on its surface; a glass oil lamp with painted pink flowers and a white shade stands on the table. A larger hanging chandelier with four red candles and gold metalwork is suspended from the ceiling above the bed. In the back left corner, a lace-curtained window is framed by heavy, gold-fringed maroon drapes closed to one side; a pedestal table beneath the window holds a domed glass vase with an arrangement of pink and white flowers. Gold wall sconces with white globes and floral decorations are mounted on either side of the curtains.
title: Bedroom, 1882
